files.description: Circuit-board trace router: octilinear traces between tiles, pads, vias, buses, rim nodes, bundle groups; window, Web Worker and Node.
Bundled traces: pulls lanes to the same target and port onto one trunk; pure geometry without DOM.
End marks: labels at traces that leave the view (board edge, zone frame, view edge), bundling, drop-down list.
End mark styles; theme via --ll-endmark-* with Lanloom token fallbacks.
Port marks: port, radio or service port at the ends of a trace, from neutral host facts.
Port mark styles; theme via --ll-portmark-* with Lanloom token fallbacks.
